body: So the problem happens when trying to do dynamic `System.import`
Boy did it take me many hours in node-inspector to track this error back to there. Would love to see that fix in beta-8. Thanks

Have you tried

``` js
System.import(`...`).then(module => cb(null, module.default))
```

@sokra thanks, this works, although that `module.default` syntax seems to be specific to Webpack, I had [not](http://www.2ality.com/2014/09/es6-modules-final.html) [seen](https://github.com/ModuleLoader/es6-module-loader#getting-started) [it](https://github.com/systemjs/systemjs#nodejs) before in conjunction with `System.import`.

In the meantime, I just looked at the issue-2443 test, and replaced all:

```
module.exports =
```

with

```
export default 
```

in `dir/one`, `dir/two`, `dir/three`, and the tests are indeed failing:

```
webpack (master)$ node_modules/.bin/mocha --harmony --full-trace --check-leaks --grep 2443
18 passing (1s)
  18 failing

  1) TestCases normal chunks issue-2443 should be able to use expressions in System.import (directory):
     AssertionError: expected Object { default: 1 } to equal 1
      at Assertion.fail (/Volumes/Users/Shared/Src/js/webpack/node_modules/should/lib/assertion.js:92:17)
      at Assertion.value (/Volumes/Users/Shared/Src/js/webpack/node_modules/should/lib/assertion.js:164:19)
      at /Volumes/Users/Shared/Src/js/webpack/test/js/normal/chunks/issue-2443/bundle.js:149:22
etc.
```

They were all passing before.

@sokra I think your suggestion of this would work:

```
System.import(`...`).then(module => cb(null, module.default))
```

How would this work with add-module-exports babel plugin? https://www.npmjs.com/package/babel-plugin-add-module-exports

@sokra @sebastienbarre hey guys, I'm trying to use dynamic imports as mentioned above

```
System.import(`./pages/${component}`).then(module => cb(null, module.default))
```

but module fails to be imported with the stack trace

```
ERROR in chunk app [entry]
2.chunk.js
Cannot read property 'length' of null
```

But it works with

```
require.ensure([], (require) => {
  cb(null, require(`./pages/${component}/index.js`))
})
```

Any suggestions how to fix that?
@valerybugakov sorry, the `module.default` trick worked for me...
@sebastienbarre do you use variable in module name too? Error happens only if I'm trying to use dynamic path for `System.import`, `System.import('./pages/Login')` works for me.
